item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
Issued at 10:00 PM 07 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(SanJose, Banton, Corcuera), #Masbate(Claveria, SanPascual), #OrientalMindoro(Naujan, CityOfCalapan, Baco, SanTeodoro, PuertoGalera, Victoria), #Albay(Oas and CityOfLigao) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Romblon(Looc, Ferrol, Odiongan, Alcantara, SantaFe, SantaMaria), #Albay(Libon), #CamarinesSur(Bato, Balatan and Nabua) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
